policy_version_date: Siffar 2.4.0 — An sabunta ta ƙarshe: Agusta 2024
policy_privacy_intro_p1: Barka da zuwa Da-Costa. Mun himmatu wajen kare sirrinka yayin samar da ingantaccen tsaro na intanet. Wannan manufar ta zayyana tsarinmu na 'Sirri-Na-Farko' game da sarrafa bayanai, musamman ga fasalulluka na Unified Security Service Edge (SSE).
policy_privacy_email_p1: Manhajar Da-Costa na ba da kariya ta ainihi daga Kasuwancin Imel (BEC) da injiniyan zamantakewa ta hanyar 'Mai Nazarin Sautin Imel & Kwaikwayo' namu.
policy_privacy_email_processing_p1: Don gano kwaikwayo, manhajar na nazarin ƙamus, tsarin jimla, da sautin imel masu shigowa. Ana yin wannan binciken ta amfani da AI mara jiha.
policy_privacy_email_retention_p1: Ba ma adana jikin imel ɗinku. Manhajar na adana 'Sa hannun Sauti' ne kawai (wakilcin lissafi na salon mai aikawa) a cikin gida a kan na'urarka don kwatantawa da saƙonni masu zuwa nan gaba.
policy_privacy_email_storage_title: 3. Adana ba tare da sabar ba:
policy_privacy_email_storage_p1: Ba a taɓa loda abubuwan imel ɗinku zuwa sabobinmu ba. Ana sarrafa shi a cikin yanayin wucewa don samar da makin haɗarin tsaro kuma ana goge shi nan da nan bayan sikanin.
policy_privacy_email_control_p1: Kuna iya cire haɗin sa ido na imel ko goge ma'ajin 'Sa hannun Sauti' na gida a kowane lokaci ta hanyar saitunan Bayanai & Sirri.
policy_privacy_guarantee1_desc: Ba ma taɓa siyar da bayananka ga wasu kamfanoni.
policy_privacy_guarantee2_desc: Ba a taɓa amfani da bayananka na tsaro for talla ba.
policy_privacy_guarantee3_desc: Ba ma bibiyar motsinka ko amfani da manhajar for bincike.
policy_privacy_guarantee4_title: Adana ba tare da girgije ba
policy_privacy_guarantee4_desc: Ba a taɓa adana saƙonni na sirri da mai jarida a cikin girgije ba.
policy_privacy_rights_title: 4. Haƙƙin Mai Amfani & Ikon Mulki na Bayanai
policy_privacy_rights_p1: A ƙarƙashin GDPR, NDPR, da CCPA, kuna da cikakken ikon mulki akan bayananku. Kuna iya fitar da lissafin bincikenku, neman gogewa nan da nan, ko soke duk izinin bango kai tsaye daga dashboard ɗin manhajar.

terms_section1_body: Ta amfani da aikace-aikacen Da-Costa, kun yarda ku daure da waɗannan Sharuɗɗan Sabis. Idan ba ku yarda ba, kada ku yi amfani da app.
terms_billing_plans_body: Aikace-aikacen Da-Costa yana ba da rajista ta Premium 'Executive Sentry'. Biyan kuɗi za a caji zuwa ga Asusun Google Play ɗinku a tabbatarwa.
terms_no_refunds_body: A matsayin sabis na stateless AI, muna ba da ƙima nan take a kunnawa. Bisa manufar Google Play ta yau da kullum, ragowar kuɗi ba ya samuwa. Damar ku za ta kasance mai aiki har ƙarshen lokacin da kuka biya.
terms_section3_body: Da-Costa yana ba da kayan aiki don nazarin tsaron yanar gizo. Kun yarda kada ku yi amfani da sabismu don wani dalili na haramta ko ba a ba da izini ba.
terms_section4_body: Aikace-aikacen yana aiki akan tsarin freemium. Ana tallafawa amfani kyauta ta hanyar tallan kaya da adadin bincike na yau da kullum. Masu amfani za su iya siyan ƙarin kuɗi ko rajistawa ga shirin premium.
terms_section5_body: Da-Costa kayan aiki ne na nazarin tsaro, ba tabbaci na aminci ba. Ba mu da alhakin wani lalaci ko asara da ya samo asali daga amfanin ku na aikace-aikacen.

deletion_stateless_body: Saboda Da-Costa yana amfani da aiki ba tare da hali na AI ba, ba mu da bayanan tsakiya na saƙonninku da aka bincika, URL, ko fayiloli don share. Ana share waɗannan abubuwa ta atomatik a cikin dakika 30 na aiki.
